authority: Owner D29 public release gate decision, 2026-10-26; audit F03/F04; concrete independent TE contract before implementation
sideEffects: Verifier never publishes. No npm publish, git push, tag push, or vendor payment calls.

input.tarballPath: actual local final compressed npm tarball

dependencies.inventory: Trusted independent frozen-source inventory: platformJobs [{key,os,node,shard,suite}], casesByTarget[os+"/"+node] mandatory for every supported target, each {product,harness} complete arrays of {file,name}; cases contains shared lab/chaos only; requiredLiveRows. Never substitute a global or another target case set, and never accept caller-declared scope. Unit source-cases.json explicitly distinguishes actual Windows collection from Linux source-registration modeling and synthetic runtime reuse. Production derives final candidate expected cases by actual collection on each OS/runtime, binding source/toolchain/collector identity; missing target inventory refuses.

github.listJobs(runId,runAttempt): Complete paginated official job array (id,run_id,head_sha,name,status,conclusion,steps); not first page only
github.downloadArtifact(artifactId): Actual ZIP Buffer, authenticated against official sha256 digest and size before interpreting any member
github.getEnvironment(name): Official npm-release response: can_admins_bypass:false; exactly one required_reviewers rule with sole User197366966/loginZilverZtream; boolean prevent_self_review (false permitted for this single-owner repository); deployment_branch_policy protected_branches:false/custom_branch_policies:true.
github.getDeploymentBranchPolicies(name): Complete paginated official deployment-policy array; exactly one {name:v1.*,type:tag}. Missing, broad, extra or branch policy refuses. protected_branches:true is insufficient when no branches are protected.

dependencies.productionBoundary: Only the exported verifier accepts injected dependencies. CLI uses fixed official GitHub endpoints and canonical repository, authenticates run/jobs/artifact identity and digest, and independently derives source inventory. Caller PASS booleans and endpoint/inventory overrides cannot authorize publication.

artifact.name: fluxwarden-release-evidence
artifact.format: ZIP of regular files; release-evidence.json and all referenced members. Missing, duplicate, traversal, checksum-mismatched or unbound members refuse.

release-evidence.json.compiledCommit: exact candidate, also inspect dist/evidence/build-info.json in actual tarball
release-evidence.json.platform: One row per independently required platform job: {jobId,key,os,node,shard,suite,report:{path,sha256},receipt:{path,sha256}}. Every exact source job actually concludes success, with no unsuccessful/skipped steps. For each OS/runtime, report union is exactly its own independent casesByTarget[os+"/"+node] product and harness inventories; no global fallback, cross-target substitution, duplicate or omitted case. Eligibility may differ between OS and runtime. Every row is nonempty.
release-evidence.json.live: {ownerPlan:{path,sha256},lab:{jobId,key,report,receipt,ownerPlan:{path,sha256}},chaos:{jobId,key,report,receipt},rows:[{id,status,evidence:{path,sha256}}]}. Shared ownerPlan binds chaos/native observations; lab.ownerPlan is separately mandatory for the distinct lab owner. Both validate exact source, exclusive:true, network:regtest and owner identity; a synthetic fixture may reuse one valid plan for both. Both complete independent lab/chaos inventories and every requiredLiveRows id must pass; GAP/PARTIAL/skips cannot become PASS.
release-evidence.json.demo: {jobId,key,evidence:{path,sha256}}. Bound JSON contains sourceCommit,compiledCommit,tarballSha256,scenarioRecord:{path,sha256},sameHashRecovery:true,sendCount:1,ledgerVerified:true,checksumsVerified:true,completeLeakScan:true. Scenario record is separately retained and bound.
release-evidence.json.publisher: {jobId,key,evidence:{path,sha256}}; bound JSON exact source/compiled/tarball,environment:npm-release,repository:ZilverZtream/fluxwarden,workflow:release.yml,package:fluxwarden,oidc:true,trustedPublisherVerified:true. Environment must also be verified via official API.

artifact.report: Vitest JSON: success:true, exact numTotalTests/numPassedTests, zero numFailedTests/numPendingTests/numTodoTests; nonempty testResults each with name and nonempty assertionResults with fullName,status:passed. Source case identity is normalized repo-relative file + fullName; every required case occurs exactly once in its appropriate union.
artifact.receipt: {sourceCommit,compiledCommit,tarballSha256,jobId,complete:true,exitCode:0,reportSha256}; binds actual retained report to actual job and final source/artifact. Authenticated artifact and actual successful official job are required in addition to these fields.
artifact.boundEvidence: Every referenced JSON evidence object has exact sourceCommit,compiledCommit,tarballSha256; its declared sha256 authenticates actual member bytes.

requiredLiveSelection.absentOrEmpty: exit 1 before live execution; offline selection remains supported without flag

workflowBinding: release.yml must invoke this gate successfully for GITHUB_SHA and the very same final tarball before npm publish. Gate failure cannot be continued, ignored, or guarded away. Retain final tarball SHA256 and authenticated evidence reference as publication evidence.

graph.dependencyPaths: Every platform/live/final-artifact producer consumes the same package producer by an actual needs dependency path and authenticated download; aggregate depends on every required producer and packages their actual artifacts/source+tarball SHA bindings. Extra package/producer/aggregate helper jobs are permitted; no fixed total104 dispatch jobs.

dispatcher.export: platformCommands(target,environment) -> {suite,commands}; target={os,node,shard}; commands ordered string[][] argv
dispatcher.execution: CLI runs these stages inside unchanged ci-capture.mjs/ci-job.mjs, retains installer verification, lint, build, database check, optional Windows core config, original suite argv, worker and shard limits, JSON report, no-pending and failure propagation. A single unconditional dispatcher replaces skipped conditional suite steps. No test-only production hook.

targetInventoryAuthentication.requiredJobs: inventory/{os}/{node} for all12targets, current source/run/attempt successful jobs with no skipped required collection steps
targetInventoryAuthentication.artifact: fluxwarden-inventory-{os}-{node}; actual authenticated ZIP digest/bytes and workflow-run/source association, inventory.json member

payload.runtime: vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH; exact minimum for pinned minima, supported matching major/minimum for moving target
payload.cases: {product,harness}: complete nonempty unique independently collected cases for this actual target

targetInventoryAuthentication.authority: CLI always authenticates actual frozen-source target collection; no caller inventory/endpoint override and no global/cross-target fallback. Unit Linux registration transform and synthetic runtime maps are never native execution proof.

publisherProtection.authority: Owner D29 verified actual repository/environment policy; reviewer is public account identity, not a credential
publisherProtection.workflow: actual release.yml retains npm-release environment; read-only CI publisher preflight does not request deployment environment and never publishes
publisherProtection.approval: Actual owner deployment approval is mandatory; YAML or a fixture is no evidence it occurred.

reportSealing.transport: github.listJobs(runId,runAttempt) returns actual current job identity/source/run
inputs: FLUXWARDEN_FINAL_TARBALL actual compressed package; metadata and complete dist bytes match frozen source dist
reportSealing.output: bounded JSON report.json/receipt.json/row.json/capture.json/owner-plan.json/T-*.json; original report bytes preserved; receipt binds source/compiled/tarball/job/report SHA256 and ACTUAL capture exit
reportSealing.pass: Every required TID has passed .live.test.ts assertion and complete retained native observations; explicit GAP/PARTIAL/INVALID raw evidence cannot become complete scenario PASS from assertion names. Unit fixtures of these formats are never native outcome evidence
reportSealing.failure: Completed failed capture retains original failed report and actual nonzero receipt; no scenario PASS authorization
reportSealing.integrity: Independently reverify unchanged original capture before producing authorized row; final entire bounded output scanned before successful return/upload. A fault injected output credential must be rejected or removed before authorization.

t18ObservationCompleteness.authority: Owner D29 LN-044-001 minimal raw binding: SPEC requires LAST_HOP_RECEIVABLE and FIRST_HOP_SPENDABLE; RESERVE_FLOOR is not a substitute
t18ObservationCompleteness.summary: T-18 evidence JSON observations:[{path,sha256}]; normalized relative authenticated artifact-member paths, no caller-narrowed variant requirement
t18ObservationCompleteness.raw: Each referenced JSON retains existing source/owner binding and raw facts, with scenario:T-18, variant:<required variant>, status:PASS|GAP|PARTIAL|INVALID
t18ObservationCompleteness.completeness: Both distinct required variants PASS. Missing raw data/reference, contradictory/incomplete retained observations, or legacy GAP without variant labels refuses completeness even when wrappers say complete:true/PASS. Do not omit contradictory retained files from the references to obtain PASS.
t18ObservationCompleteness.boundaries: Sealing, aggregation and final verification preserve incompleteness. This unit contract does not establish actual native execution.
